summary: This 8-K filing by CNL Strategic Capital, LLC reports routine monthly determinations of net asset value per share, adjustments to public offering prices, and declaration of cash distributions. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring is described. The filing is a standard operational update for a closed-end investment company, disclosing per-share NAV, offering price changes, and distribution schedules. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
